newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Tel, CITIC shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: HK Tel, CITIC shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd and CITIC Pacific Ltd was suspended on Friday, the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
Hongkong Telecom shares surged HK$0.80 to HK$15.00 on Thursday as speculation mounted about a possible link between the telecommunications giant and a Chinese partner.
The company declined to comment on its future shareholding structure at a news conference on Thursday.
China United Telecommunications Corp told reporters this week it was interested in buying a stake in Hongkong Telecom.
CITIC Pacific owns about eight percent of Hongkong Telecom.
